verdict.rationale: Gecko documents a public v1 API (trigger scans, read scan/repo/vulnerability data, triage, manage schedules, rotate tokens, webhooks) with a live OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe, plus an MCP/AI-tools integration letting agents list repos/scans and pull evidence — strong first-party and probe-verified support for programmatic, agent-driven access. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API usage/reliability and more detail on auth/rate-limit specifics beyond docs.
